summary:
LAMPLIGHT was developed as a browser-based lunar exploration experience that combines interactive gameplay with educational storytelling. Its development focused on turning space-related ideas into simple activities that players can understand and experience directly.

The game was built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Three.js. AI-assisted development tools were also used to support coding, debugging, and visual design. The project was tested with performance limitations in mind, so lightweight assets, efficient rendering, and simple interactions were important considerations.

One of the main creative decisions was to present different aspects of space exploration through three distinct missions rather than relying on long explanations. The lunar environment provides the setting, while sample collection, plant selection, and communication recovery give players practical objectives.

During development, I considered usability, visual consistency, accessibility, hardware limitations, and the balance between educational value and entertainment. I also wanted the experience to remain understandable for players without prior knowledge of space science.

LAMPLIGHT represents my effort to use digital development skills to create something educational and meaningful, while encouraging greater curiosity about space exploration.
details:
Project Details — LAMPLIGHT

LAMPLIGHT is an interactive lunar exploration game designed to introduce players to space exploration through a simple and engaging experience.

The game features three missions. In Lunar Exploration, players explore the Moon's surface and collect three lunar rock samples. In Plant Research, players choose between Zinnia, Lettuce, and Dwarf Wheat to discover basic concepts of growing plants in space environments. In Lost Signal, players interact with a communication device to restore a lost signal.

The project aims to make space science more approachable, especially for students and people who are interested in astronomy but may not have a technical background. By combining exploration, interactive objectives, and educational information, LAMPLIGHT encourages curiosity about lunar research and the challenges of future space missions.

The game was developed using web technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with Three.js for its 3D environment. Development also involved AI-assisted tools to support coding, debugging, and design iteration.

What makes LAMPLIGHT creative is its combination of a playable exploration experience and educational concepts within a lunar setting. The project was designed with accessibility, performance, simplicity, and player engagement in mind, including compatibility with lower-specification computers.

Beyond the game, LAMPLIGHT reflects the belief that digital technology can be used not only to create entertainment but also to share knowledge, inspire learning, and raise awareness about meaningful issues.
